cell_edits.source: The table's 190 is A's 186 plus 4 B events spliced into 9581.33-9587.90 (reconciled.jsonl note), where A lost the NEXT read. The frames show no locks there: amemiya lets a single I piece fall at gravity for about 6.5 s (corr/fr/g4/p127a.png, 9581.30-9587.80). The board does not change. The NEXT queue IJLSZ does not shift (nextcount.py 9580.5-9588.5: shifts at 9581.333 and then 9587.900, plus a hold of T at 9581.40). The p1 score stays 00107691 from 9581.37 to 9587.80 (score.py), not even drop points. The chain's own cseq holds 186 lock events, which equals the NEXT recount of 186. Also note: the same splice added +2 untyped lines (lines_cleared 112 vs A 110). They are equally phantom, but lines_cleared is not an editable field here.
